title: QWOP with PPO
subtitle: Learning to finish, one knee-scoot at a time
description: A PyTorch PPO agent plays the real QWOP browser game through Playwright. Six evaluation races, six 100 m finishes. Grace was not part of the reward function.
longDescription: Rebuilt in 2026 with Stable-Baselines3 PPO, PyTorch and a Gymnasium environment driving the official browser game through Playwright. Eight browser environments trained for 22 minutes. The recorded evaluation finished all six races; the best normal-speed game time was 193.8 seconds.
features: Official QWOP game in headless Chromium
OCR distance feedback and shaped rewards
Training curves, checkpoints and run GIFs
challenges: Learning a stable gait from browser-game observations
solutions: PPO with a Gymnasium environment and Playwright controls
Fixed 60-frame game seconds and explicit evaluation records
results: Completed 100 m in all six recorded evaluation races
Training run: 22 minutes across eight browser environments
